title: Unapproved charges!
body:
Worst App ever! They keep on charging my card without me subscribing and despite confirming cancellation! 

Whenever asked about the charges, they tell you it’s all in the terms and conditions! And no highlight whatsoever otherwise!

Not to mention they offer free subscription and then they charge you without your approval!
author: ElKh174
